english: The first man and the twin were brothers. Together they drove the sheep and the cattle into the field, and they found a strewn place under an oak. The oak was old. Then there the man built a hearth. He gave the fire libated honey. The gods spoke to him: "Make the sacrifice." "Seize your dear twin." He heard their word, and his heart trembled. Then he seized the twin and slew him. The twin did not cry out. That was the first sacrifice. He sat down by the hearth, and he did not speak. Then from the twin's flesh the earth came forth. From his head the sky was made. It was broad. Then from his blood the sea arose. And they gave the man good fame. He became the begetter of the people. Then the twin's name became famous.
